titulo: A gym's website, before and after
hooks: Is your gym's schedule just a photo?
Nobody signs up at a blurry gym
From pixelated flyer to booked class
voz: Schedule in a blurry photo, no membership info and music that autoplays. No wonder nobody wants to come in. In the new version you see today's classes, the schedule reads at a glance and a button lets you book your first trial class.

despues.titular: Train on your schedule, no hassle

captions: Someone looking for a gym wants to know what classes there are, at what time and how to get started. If your website shows that at a glance, that first step gets a lot easier.
A blurry photo of your schedule can't be read on a phone, and Google can't read it either. A real schedule grid can.
Booking a first trial class with one button takes the fear out of getting started. Your trainers handle the rest.
